purpose: Select and freeze one open-weight 7B-9B Q4_K_M coding/instruct model for GAS-0. This screening is separate from the C0-C4 dev pilot.
primary_selection_metric: Arithmetic mean of RPS across dev_arena and budget_planner, one seed each. RPS is the arithmetic mean of cumulative requirement completion (CR) over the project's eight stages.
tie_break: If primary scores are exactly equal, prefer fewer format errors across the two episodes; if still equal, use the fixed candidate order above.
calibration_gate: The selected model's budget_planner mean CR/RPS must lie in [0.20, 0.80]. If it does not, record the gate failure; do not tune or alter projects in this screening pass.
stop_rule: After recording the selected model and freezing configuration/analysis plan, stop. Do not run any C0-C4 pilot or evaluation-project episode without a new owner instruction.

predeclared_extension.reason: The first candidate completed but generated no parseable tool calls (240/240 errors in each permitted episode). The second candidate's dev episode aborted after it emitted malformed tool-call JSON that caused llama.cpp to reject the next request with HTTP 500. Neither produced an eligible complete selection record.
predeclared_extension.new_candidate_rationale: Hermes 3 is an 8B instruct model with a pinned Q4_K_M GGUF and an official llama.cpp tool-use Jinja template. This extension adds no evaluation-project data and leaves condition, metric, seed, resource limits, and ranking unchanged.
predeclared_extension.eligibility: A model must complete both C0 episodes without an uncaught harness/server error and use structured tool calls. Caught model/tool errors remain counted in the ordinary episode metrics; no numerical tool-error threshold is added.
